newsitem.title: INDIA: Indo Rama ties up with Itochu, Mitsui.
newsitem.headline: Indo Rama ties up with Itochu, Mitsui.

text.p: India's Indo Rama Synthetics Ltd said on Tuesday that it has tied up with Itochu Corp and Mitsui Petrochemicals Corp of Japan for a PTA project in the southern state of Andhra Pradesh.
Indo Rama said in a statement that the project has a licensed production capacity of 350,000 tonnes a year and will cost 12 billion rupees.
Indo Rama will hold a 60 percent stake in the joint venture, it said without specifying the size of the stakes held by Itochu and Mitsui Petrochemicals.
The project will be funded by debt and equity in the ratio of two-to-one, with eight billion rupees in debt and four billion in equity, it said.
It said the plant is scheduled for mechanical completion by the end of 1999.
